text:
alex: Heads-up — pushing kernel+quant bundle to staging at 19:00 PT. Bundle: kernel v3.8.2, quant-profile v4, kv-cache alignment patch. Anyone blocking?

mira: Not blocking. Can infra pin the staging image tag so smoke runs are stable?

sam: +1 pin. Please have deploy-bot run preflight checks and start with a 5% canary. Add a holdback label so we can kill traffic quickly.

alex: Plan: 19:00 start, 5% for 10m, evaluate smoke + perf dashboards, then 25% for 20m, then ramp if green. Rollback window: 19:40-20:10 final decision.

deploy-bot: preflight started for image redwood/runtime:staging-2026-03-21-kvfix (job id: 7421). Running: lint, container-scan, kernel-compat-check, quant-selftest. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/7421

jordan: Watch list: KV cache hitrate, p99 generation latency, OOM counts, ephemeral GPU memory fragmentation. I added a smoke script: `scripts/smoke_staging.sh` (timeout 6m).

mira: Release notes draft: "kv cache alignment fix — reduces prefix mismatch; quant kernel ABI bump — improves perf for longer seqs; quant-profile v4 adds fallback for small-batch workloads." I'll ping docs for a short blurb.

sam: Acceptance criteria before 25%: 1) error-rate delta <=3% vs baseline, 2) p95 < baseline+120ms, 3) no OOMs on staging hosts for 15m. Any trigger -> pin to kernel v3.8.1 + quant-profile v3 and roll back.

alex: Ack. If preflight fails, hold. If canary is noisy, pause and run focused diag. Jordan — if kv hitrate drops >10% surface it ASAP.

deploy-bot: preflight finished — kernel-compat-check: OK, quant-selftest: WARNING (minor numeric diffs on fp16 path). Full log: https://ci.internal/reports/7421#quant-selftest

jordan: FP16 diffs expected but let's confirm no token-level perplexity regressions. Running `python eval/compare_fp16.py --baseline v3.8.1 --candidate v3.8.2`.

mira: Add rollback steps and pin commands to the rollout note: `infra tag pin runtime=redwood/runtime:v3.8.1-20260320` and `deploy-bot rollback --image redwood/runtime:v3.8.1-20260320`.

sam: I'll attach emergency rollback snippet to the staging release doc.

alex: Starting canary at 19:00 -> 5%. Posting updates here.

[~20 minutes later]

alex: Canary 5% done. Smoke passed. Metrics: error-rate +0.6%, p95 +40ms, no OOMs. Moving to 25% for 20m.

jordan: Eval script shows token perplexity delta +0.3% on small-batch eval — within tolerance. FP16 diffs look cosmetic.

mira: Release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/engine/2026-03-21-kvfix-draft (please add reviewers).

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 25% complete. Monitoring hooks active.

sam: If anything odd, execute rollback plan below. Otherwise aim to finish ramp at 21:00 and publish release notes at 21:15.

alex: Thanks — keep eyes on dashboards. If abort needed, call `runtime-roll` pager and use the pin command above. :thumbsup:
